about: Hotel logos of the free hotel list cards (cream logo column) and the tourism marks of their foot. Each file is copied unaltered from the official source named here (the hotel, its chain, the tourism body, or Wikimedia Commons). Load through only, never inline (some SVGs carry generic

amsterdam-inn.svg.licence: Trademark of Amsterdam Inns. Official file from amsterdaminns.com, used unaltered to name the hotel in a guest-information list.

arts-hotel.png.licence: Trademark of The Arts Hotel. Official file from theartshotel.ca, used unaltered to name the hotel in a guest-information list.
arts-hotel.png.note: The logo is drawn on its own white plate: shows as a white panel on cream and on dark. The "inverted" file on its site looks the same.

best-western-plus.png.licence: Trademark of Best Western International. Official file from bestwestern.com brand logos, used unaltered to name the hotel in a guest-information list.
best-western-plus.png.note: Red BW, grey "Best Western" sinks on the dark card. 300 px wide.

blackbush-beach-resort.jpg.licence: Trademark of Blackbush Beach Resort. Official file from blackbush.ca, used unaltered to name the hotel in a guest-information list.
blackbush-beach-resort.jpg.note: JPEG on an opaque white ground: shows as a white tile.
